The resulting chronological motion must be frame 9 crouch → frame 10 half rising → frame 11 almost standing → frame 12 quiet standing. Both feet support weight on the ground; knees progressively straighten; hips and head rise smoothly vertically. The head NEVER gets bigger or smaller. Hands remain below chest, close to the knees/thighs and torso, helping the rise. Hair falls downward naturally rather than whipping out. Face is focused and relaxed, mouth tiny and nearly closed.

Arms smoothly draw toward the final relaxed pose, elbows near the body, hands below chest. Calm almost-closed or closed tiny mouth. Hair and tail settle toward the exact final silhouette. This is a gentle continuation, NOT a wobble or recovery gesture.
Both new poses should look like nearby consecutive frames of the existing sprite, not new character designs. Match the lower-right reference character for clothing/face rendering and body scale; do not beautify, add detail or change style. Preserve full unclipped hair, ears, horns, hands, feet and tail within each cell, with transparent bottom margin. Output the same transparent 2×2 sheet, preferably 960×960.

processing: Adopted lossless preview atlases are the build inputs. PNG conversion preserves RGBA pixels; the build derives hit rows from those final pixels. Flutter plays three authored cycles then completes (840 ms). Dragging support is adjusted by at most 2 source pixels to avoid window clipping.
leftFacing: The build mirrors each frame while counter-mirroring RGB in the recorded ZZZ regions. The alpha mask and hit geometry remain exact mirrors.
